integrity: Two complete, standard-library Python verifiers separately enumerate the Hamiltonian paths and the backbite graph and check all exact metric and endpoint counts. Reproduction depends on running and checking these finite algorithms.
scientific_limitations: Finite classification for the explicitly labelled eleven-vertex Herschel graph and the endpoint-backbite operation only; no mixing-time bound or general family theorem. Historical priority remains qualified; independent scholarly audit has not been performed.
title: Exact backbite distances among Hamiltonian paths of the Herschel graph
